text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we've been invited to a hero<n>stage show
planned by Biko Pegasus<n>and her friends.

text_block_list.name: Evil Lackeys
text_block_list.text:
Anyone hit by our Wide-Eyes Beam<n>won't be able
to sleep at night! Now,<n>which brat should we shoot?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, c'mon! This is so irritatin'! I<n>can't watch
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're supposed to explain theweapon's effect after you use it!That way, the fear gradually creeps up on 'em!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And don't attack until you've already<n>picked a
target! If you waste precious<n>time deciding, the
heroes will—
Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hero of justice, Biko Pegasus, has<n>arrived! I
protect the peace in this city!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself! Pegasus Puuunch!

text_block_list.name: Evil Lackeys
text_block_list.text: Aaarrrghhh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Justice always prevails!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugh, geez! This happens every single<n>ti—
Eat this! Wide-Eyes Beeeaaam!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Arrrghhh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Guh... What was that?! I'm sure I had<n>wiped out all
the villains! Who goes<n>there?!
Heh heh heh! You merely defeated<n>my lackeys!

text_block_list.name: Sleepless Demon Buono
text_block_list.text: Say your prayers, Biko Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I used up all my power in that<n>last battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus finds herself in a real<n>bind. However,
she's able to regain<n>her strength through the
cheers of the<n>children.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Take this! Pegasus Kiiick!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So, what did you think? Pretty neat<n>show, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was on the edge of my seat!
Yeah, I was on the edge of my seat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: For sure! That was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm talkin' about Sleepless Demon<n>Buono of
course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The way you used your lackeys to<n>lure the hero in
and then made your<n>own cool entrance at the
perfect<n>moment!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're a real evil boss! I wanna be<n>just like you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Which means first I need some<n>lackeys...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: Uh, why are you staring at me?
Uh, why are you staring at me?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait. I already have one. You just<n>need a little
fixin' up, is all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Now, you're gonna obey my every<n>command! Got
that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Don't expect any mercy from me<n>either!
choice_data_list: I don't know if I'm cut out for villainy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Disobeying your boss,<n>are we?!
Cheeky lackeys like you<n>need to be punished!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Stop it, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you intend to get in my way,<n>Biko Pegasus?!
You don't have what<n>it takes to stop me!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, is the show starting<n>again? Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy and Biko Pegasus<n>engage in a
grueling battle as they're<n>showered with cheers
from the<n>excited children.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! That's what I like to hear!<n>You've got
promise!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! As a hero, I can't sit by and<n>watch an
innocent person fall into the<n>clutches of evil!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I won't allow this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! You'll do well as a first<n>opponent!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sic 'em, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hey, is the show starting<n>again? It looks like
there's a new bad<n>guy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Good and evil become locked in a<n>vicious struggle
as we're showered<n>with cheers from the excited
children.
